tagline: Count every reel when it comes back
headline: 4 reels counted in one X-ray shot
subhead: Counts through the closed tape, reads every barcode, syncs MES and prints the new label.
one_paragraph_answer: The Smart EMS X3100 from Southern Machinery is an X-ray component counter for SMT warehouses: up to four reels are imaged in one shot and counted in 6 - 10 s (chip 0201), down to 01005 parts; a 20 MP camera reads every reel barcode, the quantity goes to MES, ERP or WMS and a new label is printed.

pains.h: Lines stop for parts the system says you have
pains.b: Returned reels keep their original label quantity.

pains.h: Counting costs labour and opens sensitive packs
pains.b: Tape-wheel counters handle one reel at a time.
Cycle counts need a quantity per reel ID.
